changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > FX TRACK turns a MIDI track into an effects track: the control changes a MIDI track sends on FX CONTROL CH for the delay (CC 85-92), reverb (CC 24-31), compressor (CC 111-119) and External Mixer (CC 102-109) go into the Digitakt's own MIDI handling instead of out of MIDI OUT and USB, so parameter locks and the track's LFO play the effects. Unticked, MIDI output is stock.

The setting is not saved and starts unticked at every power-on. Notes and every other message still go out; messages also reach any track whose TRACK CHANNEL equals FX CONTROL CH. Hardware behaviour is not yet verified on a unit; see TESTING.md.
